levels.name: Dew-Drinker
levels.description: Taking DMG from a Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrow or Frostflake Arrow Bloom decreases opponents' Cryo RES by 15% for 6s. A hit regenerates 2 Energy for Ganyu. This effect can only occur once per Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrow, regardless if Frostflake Arrow itself or its Bloom hit the target.

levels.name: The Auspicious
levels.description: Trail of the Qilin gains 1 additional charge.

levels.name: Cloud-Strider
levels.description: Increases the Level of Celestial Shower by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Westward Sojourn
levels.description: Opponents standing within the AoE of Celestial Shower take increased DMG. This effect strengthens over time. Increased DMG taken begins at 5% and increases by 5% every 3s, up to a maximum of 25%. The effect lingers for 3s after the opponent leaves the AoE.

levels.name: The Merciful
levels.description: Increases the Level of Trail of the Qilin by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: The Clement
levels.description: Using Trail of the Qilin causes the next Frostflake Arrow shot within 30s to not require charging.
